# Tackle
Tackle is a combat move that allows the user to dive some distance forward, knocking down the first victim on their path.
To perform a tackle you must have a special kind of gloves with tackle ability.
Tackle can be performed once every 3.5 seconds with [color=yellow]Alt-Q[/color] key by default.
Be aware that you will knock yourself down and drop all held items when performing a tackle. Also avoid any obstacles such as walls, as they may cause an unhappy landing.
Tackle outcome is determined by multiple factors (modifiers), such as: user/victim health, stamina damage, user speed, victim stamina protection and the gloves modifier itself.
Tackle will knock down your target and deal some stamina damage to them, and good tackle with high modifier make the user stand up.
Different kind of gloves have different tackle modifier to them, as well as different speed, range and knockdown time. All gloves, have an "unsafe" minimum tackle distance - if you fly range is any lower than that and you hit something, your head will hurt, especially if you hit a wall.
Tackle costs some amount of stamina to perform, this value varies depending on the gloves.
